notes:
- Account: customer support for 2M monthly inbound emails (peak events up to 15M/day).
- Primary need: fast, accurate ticket + email summarization and auto-tagging to reduce agent triage time.
- Wants: single-line summary + 3 bullet action items, auto-tag taxonomy compatible with Zendesk macros and Freshdesk workflows.
- Spike resiliency is critical: major marketing events produce 6-8x baseline traffic for 48-72 hours. They need graceful degradation (fallback to smaller model) and routing by policy.
- Quoted on kickoff call: "If summaries take longer than 250ms avg we lose value for live agent assist" — product head.
- Preference: start hosted API for quick iteration, then move to Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) for Q4 holiday spikes. VPC + KMS for customer PII.
- Security: asking for SOC2 report, SSO/SAML integration details, audit log retention options, and EU data residency.
- Integration: Zendesk (macros/triggers), Freshdesk, internal workflow engine (webhook-based tool-calling to update ticket fields).
- POC acceptance criteria: reduce average triage time by 30%, tagging precision > 85% on sampled set, <1% critical hallucinations on action items.
- Pricing sensitivity: mid — willing to commit if ROI < 9 months.
- Internal champions: VP Support (Eva Thornton), Head of AI Ops (Samir Patel).
- Contact cadence: weekly sync Thurs 10am PT with SE + AE.
- Notes style: fragments, call quotes, quick action items.
